freeze_timing: Frozen while Phase-6 target scoring is still in progress, before Phase-6/7/8 adjudications are visible.
purpose: Confirmatory assessment of the final frozen mechanism+cipher ordering against Voynich consequences not used to discover the Saltzman origin-state mechanism.

discovery_metrics_excluded.rule: The four Saltzman Q metrics may be reported descriptively but cannot contribute to Phase-9 adjudication or model selection.

metric_source.tolerances: the pre-existing v2 empirical TOLERANCES in that file
metric_source.vms_target: the pre-existing VMS baseline used by the 85-metric suite; do not recompute from a transformed representation after Phase-8 results

loss.per_document: median normalized loss over the 24 locked metrics
loss.primary_gain: per_document_loss(cipher_only) - per_document_loss(final_pipeline); positive means the final pipeline improves held-out Voynich fit

family_guard.rule: Compute the median normalized-loss gain within each of the six metric families. A broad improvement requires positive median gain in at least five of six families.
family_guard.catastrophic_degradation: No family may have median gain < -0.5 normalized tolerance units.

metrics: exact-token adjacent-repeat rate across line boundaries minus matched within-line adjacent-repeat rate
absolute word-length difference across line boundaries minus matched within-line adjacent word-length difference
line_boundary_holdout.target: Compute once on the frozen Voynich transcription/lineation used by the existing scorer, with line-level bootstrap 95% intervals.
line_boundary_holdout.model_rule: For cipher-only and final pipeline, compute the same two contrasts on synthetic lines without fitting any threshold or state parameter.
line_boundary_holdout.use: Secondary confirmatory prediction; direction and interval overlap are reported, not used to choose among Phase-8 orderings.

primary_adjudication.CONFIRMATORY_BROAD_IMPROVEMENT: Primary gain lower 95% CI > 0, at least 5/6 families have positive median gain, and no family violates catastrophic-degradation guard.

representation_robustness.rule: ATOMIC/LITERAL are mandatory. RF/STA/aaa are run only if their frozen transliterations and VMS targets can be recovered without re-estimation; they are robustness extensions, never a basis for tuning the final pipeline.
